en: "What are you doing?" someone asked her one afternoon.
ja: 「何をしているの？」ある日の午後、誰かが彼女に尋ねた。
answer: "What are you doing?" someone asked her one afternoon.

en: Mina looked up from the ground.
ja: ミーナは地面から顔を上げた。
answer: Mina looked up from the ground.

en: A boy about her age stood on the path, holding a paper bag from the bakery.
ja: 同じくらいの年の男の子が、パン屋の紙袋を持って道に立っていた。
answer: A boy about her age stood on the path, holding a paper bag from the bakery.

en: "I'm Tommy," he said.
ja: 「僕はトミー」と彼は言った。
answer: "I'm Tommy," he said.

en: "What's your name?"
ja: 「あなたは？」
answer: "What's your name?"

en: "I'm Mina," she answered.
ja: 「私はミーナ」と彼女は答えた。
answer: "I'm Mina," she answered.

en: "I'm picking up time."
ja: 「時間を拾っているのよ」
answer: "I'm picking up time."

en: Tommy blinked.
ja: トミーは目をぱちくりさせた。
answer: Tommy blinked.

en: "Time?" he said.
ja: 「時間？」と彼は言った。
answer: "Time?" he said.

en: "You can pick up time?"
ja: 「時間って拾えるの？」
answer: "You can pick up time?"

en: "Yes," said Mina.
ja: 「そう」とミーナは言った。
answer: "Yes," said Mina.

en: "These shining grains are time."
ja: 「この光っている粒は、時間なの」
answer: "These shining grains are time."

en: "Everyone drops a little of it, every single day."
ja: 「みんなが毎日、少しずつ落としていくのよ」
answer: "Everyone drops a little of it, every single day."

en: "Most people walk right past them without noticing."
ja: 「ほとんどの人は、気づかずに通り過ぎてしまうけど」
answer: "Most people walk right past them without noticing."

en: She held her bottle out toward him.
ja: 彼女は瓶を彼のほうへ差し出した。
answer: She held her bottle out toward him.

en: "But you can see them too, can't you?"
ja: 「でもあなたには見えるのね？」
answer: "But you can see them too, can't you?"

en: Tommy did not answer.
ja: トミーは答えなかった。
answer: Tommy did not answer.

en: He was staring into the bottle, his eyes wide.
ja: 目を見開いて、瓶の中をじっと見つめていた。
answer: He was staring into the bottle, his eyes wide.

en: Inside, the grains of light were shining silver.
ja: その中で、光の粒は銀色に輝いていた。
answer: Inside, the grains of light were shining silver.

en: For the first time, Mina was not the only one.
ja: 生まれてはじめて、ミーナは一人ではなかった。
answer: For the first time, Mina was not the only one.
